race.comment: GO LEFT (1) returns for a new stable after tackling stronger Victorian races last campaign and tuning up with a comfortable Gold Coast Poly trial win. Her figures over this sort of trip and on good ground read well enough to make her the horse to beat. SUBSIDING (2) is the biggest threat, having won a Mdn at this track by two and a half lengths as an odds-on favourite and now gets to build again third-up from barrier one. Can keep the ball rolling. VETOED (3) was beaten a head at this venue last start and is already a track-and-trip winner. Only gunned down late last start and he'll be tough to run down once again from the front. SO BE INSPIRED (7) was only a length from ALL TOO ROSEY at Murwillumbah, has won at her only start at this track, and can press for a minor result if she lifts from the Gold Coast Poly run two back. ALL TOO ROSEY (4) won't be far away.
